series: Gartner Top Strategic Predictions (Top Predictions for IT Organizations and Users)

entries.quote: By 2015, a G20 nation's critical infrastructure will be disrupted and damaged by online sabotage.
entries.subject: Online sabotage of critical infrastructure

entries.quote: By 2015, new revenue generated each year by IT will determine the annual compensation of most new Global 2000 CIOs.
entries.subject: CIO compensation tied to IT revenue

entries.quote: By 2015, information-smart businesses will increase recognized IT spending per head by 60 percent.
entries.subject: IT spending per head
entries.metric: increase in recognized IT spending per head at information-smart businesses

entries.quote: By 2015, tools and automation will eliminate 25 percent of labor hours associated with IT services.
entries.subject: Automation of IT services labor
entries.metric: share of IT services labor hours eliminated

entries.quote: By 2015, 20 percent of non-IT Global 500 companies will be cloud service providers.
entries.subject: Non-IT companies as cloud providers
entries.metric: share of non-IT Global 500 companies that are cloud service providers

entries.quote: By 2014, 90 percent of organizations will support corporate applications on personal devices.
entries.subject: Corporate applications on personal devices
entries.metric: share of organizations supporting corporate apps on personal devices

entries.quote: By 2013, 80 percent of businesses will support a workforce using tablets.
entries.subject: Tablets in the workforce
entries.metric: share of businesses supporting a workforce using tablets

entries.quote: By 2015, 10 percent of your online "friends" will be nonhuman.
entries.subject: Nonhuman social media friends
entries.metric: share of online friends that are nonhuman

notes: Edition covers '2011 and beyond'. Gartner's stated count: not stated (press release states no count). Found in public source: 8 top predictions. Client report: "Gartner's Top Predictions for IT Organizations and Users, 2011 and Beyond: IT's Growing Transparency" (paywalled). gartner.com returns 403 to scripted fetches; text read from the Internet Archive snapshot listed in sources. Second edition published in calendar 2010 (the January 2010 edition covers '2010 and beyond'). File named 2010-11 to keep one file per edition. Quotes are the prediction headline sentences as printed in the press release; body text is not stored.
